description: Geospatial, Geotechnical, and Geophysical Characterization for Modeling Levee Performance During Susquehanna River Flood Events is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Kaleigh Yost, Penn State University (psu.edu). This project contains data collected on a levee system located in Luzerne County, Pennsylvania. Specifically, two levee segments were captured: the Forty Fort levee and the Kingston levee. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: flood; geophysical; geospatial, LiDAR, CPT, DMT, HVSR, Bathymetry. Published 2026-02-05. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
